title: Forward-oriented predicate substitution fails under translation
situation: Forward point translation sends 0 to 1. Applying forward again to target coordinate 1 yields 2, so source P(x)=x=0 becomes false.
attempted_conclusion: Preserve source P using the forward map as target predicate substitution.

expected.reason: The wrong orientation evaluates P(2), losing the true source predicate P(0).
